news.title: Sangales Group Announces Comprehensive Digital Infrastructure Launch
news.excerpt: The launch of Sangales.com marks a pivotal milestone in creating a unified corporate presence across all operating companies.
news.content:
SANGALES – A GROUP OF COMPANIES has officially inaugurated its consolidated corporate digital portal, establishing a single authoritative touchpoint for clients, institutional partners, and suppliers worldwide.

Under this unified architecture, each operating business—including Annamrit Foods, Sangales Farms, Sangales Enterprises, Sangales Trading, and Sangales Packaging—maintains distinct operational profiles while benefiting from the group's collective governance, financial resilience, and brand stature.

Speaking on the launch, the leadership emphasized: "Our vision is to build sustainable, deeply rooted Indian enterprises that generate real economic value, create local employment, and foster long-term partnerships. This platform represents our transparent, progressive identity as we look ahead to future expansions in modern technology and distribution."
news.seoTitle: Sangales Group Announces Digital Platform Launch | Corporate Press
news.seoDescription: Official announcement regarding the consolidated corporate digital ecosystem for Sangales – A Group of Companies.

news.title: Annamrit Foods Expands Natural Cold-Pressed & Stone-Ground Processing Facility
news.excerpt: New zero-heat milling and wood-pressed oil units commissioned to meet surging demand for unadulterated staple foods.
news.content:
To keep pace with growing consumer affinity for pure, unadulterated staple nutrition, Annamrit Foods has expanded its specialized processing facility with advanced stone-ground milling units and stainless steel clean-room packaging lines.

The expanded capacity allows Annamrit Foods to scale the production of whole-grain flours, unrefined forest honey, and wood-pressed seed oils without utilizing high temperatures, thereby conserving essential micronutrients and natural flavors.

All output continues to undergo stringent multi-point batch tests for purity, moisture content, and zero pesticide residues before reaching retail shelves and institutional kitchens.
news.seoTitle: Annamrit Foods Expands Processing Facility | Sangales News
news.seoDescription: Annamrit Foods scales natural cold-pressed oil and stone-ground heritage flour production with expanded facility.

news.title: Sangales Packaging Introduces Certified Compostable Food Containers
news.excerpt: The packaging division deepens its sustainable product portfolio with 100% plant-fiber food delivery containers.
news.content:
Addressing the imperative need for sustainable alternatives to single-use plastics in the food service sector, Sangales Packaging has introduced an eco-engineered lineup of molded bagasse and unbleached kraft paper meal containers.

The new containers are certified 100% compostable, grease-resistant up to 120°C, and fully microwave-safe, providing restaurants, cloud kitchens, and institutional caterers with an ecologically sound yet structurally robust packaging choice.
news.seoTitle: Sangales Packaging Unveils Compostable Containers | Sangales Group
news.seoDescription: Sangales Packaging launches certified biodegradable, plant-fiber food containers for hospitality and delivery partners.
